Bug B29 · S2 · known

Nursing Home residents have no Facility field: it cannot be entered, is not shown and cannot be searched

Tickets: TFA-92581 AC3 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-03/S11

Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S10 Nursing Home facility: no facility exists on the ready-for-qa build (AC 3 facility part)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 3; TFA-92581 AC 6)
  • U6 Nursing Home identity fields are name, unit/room, MRN and facility. (UAT TC-03)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Build e02167f (TFA-92581 is ready for qa and claims AC 3 is done)

When Read, read-only, the snf resident schema and residentFields, snf:add, src/routes/snf/AddResident.tsx, SnfPatientCard and matchesPatientSearch (convex/lib/patientList.ts) for a facility field; confirm on the running app with S11's form snapshot and S09's card snapshots

Then A resident can be given a facility, the card shows it, and Nursing Home search matches it

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Doc review of a code fact, signed off by a person. No facility field in the record, the add mutation, the Add Resident form, the card or the search matcher means a physician cannot enter, see or search by facility. U4's facility part and U6's facility field are reported as Fail on TFA-92581. This holds whatever Q1 decides about where facility comes from. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method CODEREVIEW · Code review; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S10 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92581 ready for qa

A Nursing Home resident has no facility anywhere: it cannot be entered on Add Resident, it is not on the card, and search cannot find residents by facility.

Evidence: code-review known-gap (known:no-facility). No facility in snfFields, snf:add, AddResident, SnfPatientCard or matchesPatientSearch. Already in dev report §4 (TFA-92581 AC 3). Q1 (where facility comes from) is open, but the oracle says the Fail holds whatever Q1 decides.
